subject: Science
topicName: Chemistry - Lesson 3: Combination and Decomposition Reactions
description: Identify combination and decomposition reactions by reading reaction patterns, counting reactants and products, and connecting the patterns to real examples.
learningObjectives: Describe a combination reaction as two or more reactants forming one product
Describe a decomposition reaction as one reactant breaking into two or more products
Recognize the general patterns A + B -> AB and AB -> A + B
Classify common chemical equations as combination or decomposition reactions
Explain why counting reactants and products helps identify reaction type
prerequisites: Recognizing reactants and products in a chemical equation
Reading the arrow in a chemical equation as 'yields' or 'produces'
Understanding that chemical formulas represent substances
Basic familiarity with atoms, molecules, and conservation of matter
